text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.timer_comba: Enable or disable the combat timer
Enable or disable the desk timer
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.timer_fugde: Enable or disable the crate timer
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.timer_box.@: Enable or disable the box timer
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.fishing_ale: Enable receiving an alert when holding a rod under/at 3 dura
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.actionbar_s: Display a text over the actionbar when you are in a riot session, chocolate session, or in combat
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.contraband_: Color the tooltip red when the hovered item is contraband
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.cape_textur: Custom cape variation to display on your player (REQUIRES REJOIN)
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.custom_cape: Enable showing the selected custom mlum cape on your player instead of the vanilla cape
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.escape_soun: Sound to play when "esc" or "escape" appear in chat (requires notifications on)
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.escsounds.@: Notify whenever "esc" or "escape" appear in chat
Show a style meter on the screen when fighting just like ULTRAKILL's style meter
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.astylemeter: Always show style meter regardless of score
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.toasts.@Too: Disable timer/notification toasts from showing up and only send chat messages
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.itemcosts.@: Replace the typical "• 1x Item Here" with a check or an X depending on if you have the material in crafting GUIs
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.chatmode.@T: Show four buttons (all-chat, team-chat, gang-chat, mod-chat) above chat input box to select a message destination
Notify you when a guard slot opens
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.progtrack.@: Shows a progress tracker to getting chocolate over the actionbar. Ex: "Rake 5/11"
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.progtrackhi: Offsets the job progress HUD by the selected amount
text.autoconfig.mlumm.option.bmdelay.@To:
How many milliseconds to wait after pressing "BID" in the black market screen before making your client type the bid into the sign.
The server takes around 100-200ms to open the sign to bid (depending on lag). If you or the server is laggy you may also want to increase this.
Minimum of 200ms because any faster has a much higher chance to cause a bug and it may be unfair.
